ios.desc:
bloopworm is an AI based manga, webtoon (manhwa) & comic reader. This app focuses on one goal: to make the digital experience just as fun as reading physical comic books.

Features:

• Effortless Navigation: Slide through pages and zoom in on panels with our intuitive image viewer.

• Smart Reading: bloopworm's guided view automatically detects panels and text, so you can enjoy comics in their natural format, whether it's webtoon, manga, or traditional comic book layouts.

• Multiple Reading Modes: Read from left to right, right to left, or choose auto-detect for a hassle-free experience.

• View Your Way: Go horizontal or vertical, whichever feels most comfortable for you.

• Widespread File Support: bloopworm opens all your favorite image formats (JPG, JPEG, PNG, and WEBP) and compressed files (CBZ, CBR, RAR, ZIP, and PDF).

• Import from Anywhere: Easily import or extract manga, comics & webtoons (manhwa) from any folder on your device.

• Organized Library: Our built-in file management system lets you keep your comic collection organized, so you can always find what you're looking for.

Privacy policy and terms of use: https://www.agreement.bloopworm.com
